recent.text: The #mnwild completed a 5-2 win over San Jose and moved to 18-3-5 on the season and leads the NHL with 41 points. The Wild also extended its point streak to 15 contests and set a new franchise record, besting 14 games from Feb. 17 to March 15, 2023.
recent.author: Minnesota Wild PR

recent.text: The #mnwild extends its point streak to a franchise record 15 games (12-0-3) and its road point streak to 11 games (10-0-1), T-3rd longest in team history. Kirill Kaprizov extends his point streak to a franchise record 15 games (8-24=32). #ThisIsFun!!!
recent.author: Aaron Sickman

recent.text: The #mnwild improves to 18-3-5 (.788) and leads the NHL with 41 points - a franchise record through 26 games. #WinningIsFun!!!
